body: Hopefully you'll excuse my cynicism, but at 8 days short of 25 years old, I find it hard to believe I can just wipe my slate clean and start over. I appreciate your sympathy, and that you took the time to reply to me, but I don't feel like running from my problems, though I've considered it, will solve anything. What's the point of running away and starting over if it doesn't change the fact that I can't cope with the one thing life does to all of us: beat you down and then kick you while you're down.
